channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Copeland | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Copeland from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Larry Bird on Chris Copeland
item.description:
Michael Lee:Larry Bird:

“We are aware that Chris Copeland was injured early this morning... Our thoughts are with Chris and those injured.”

Larry Bird on Chris Copeland, Apr 8, 2015. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Chris Copeland
item.description:
While discussing his bench, Pacers coach Frank Vogel stressed the problem of lots of talent, not enough time.

“We have Chris Copeland, who I can’t find enough minutes for, who’s going to be a big-time threat for us,”

Frank Vogel on Chris Copeland, Nov 10, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Chris Copeland
item.description:
“There was money still left to get Copeland, but he got a better deal. So we've got to live with that.”

Mike Woodson on Chris Copeland, Jul 12, 2013. Source: Sulia.
